Longterm Usage
I have suffered from anxiety and back pain since I was 18. I have tried every alternative medicine I could get my hands on. Kratom tends to make me sick after I consume more than 3,500 mg, and that dose doesnt do much for me. Passionflower doesnt seem to work. Kava did not help. Valerian root makes me stay awake and feel edgy for some reason. Alcohol is great, but it leads to a vicious circle that tends to do more harm than good.
I started consuming CBD 6 months ago. Like any newbie, I bargain shopped at the beginning and got what I paid for (which was mostly placebo effect). I was about to give up on CBD too, but came across a company that claimed they were different [ ]. I live around the area in [ ] and decided to drive up there to give CBD one more shot.
I am really glad that I did!
This occurred about 3 months into experimenting with CBD. I take CBD both orally (25 mg) and I vape it too. The effects from taking it orally lasts about 8 hours for me. The effects dont last as long when vaping it, but the effects kick in really quick. I like to consume CBD orally before work. If I need to run to a supermarket later in the day, then a few puffs of my vape pen does the trick to calm the nerves.
My pain and anxiety are both under control now. I do not get high from CBD. There is a feeling to it though that was difficult for me to put my finger on at the beginning. Its kind of like being stoned but without the head change. It actually gives me better focus.
Its kind of like being stoned but without the head change. It actually gives me better focus.
Think of how your mind felt when you were a kid before you were forced to dwell over work issues, spousal issues, other personal problems, and wear and tear on your body. I feel younger!
CBD is not known as a recreational drug, but when you have to deal with anxiety on a daily basis, it sure makes life more enjoyable. My family and friends tell me that they see a positive change in me!
